lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs; the central row exhibits the largest and most distinct local maxima with a regular longitudinal spacing of approximately one blob diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, elongated silhouette of a commensal fish (remora) is visible positioned ventrally to the primary mid-flank blob constellation.
